'''Equet''' was an individual who ran a weapons shop in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Equet was recruiting tough men and women for [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].
